metric_definitions.error: prediction minus actual; MAE/RMSE use valid actual targets only
metric_definitions.difference: model metric minus persistence metric; negative favors the model
metric_definitions.cumulative: pooled errors over all lead hours 1 through the horizon across completed windows
metric_definitions.baseline: AQI observed at the origin repeated for all 24 lead hours
